title: Crestline Summit Club Membership Terms — Renewal, Grace Period and Lapse
content:
## Renewal terms of the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships

**R1. Due date.** Renewal dues for the next membership year fall due on the membership's renewal date and are charged automatically when auto-renew is on for that membership. The member may pay them from the membership's early-renewal period of calendar days before the renewal date.

**R2. Grace.** A membership whose renewal date passes unpaid enters grace. Renewal dues can be paid no later than the renewal date plus the membership's grace period in days.

**R3. Counting the grace period.** The grace period is counted in calendar days from the renewal date, and a payment on its last day is accepted. The renewal date recorded on the membership is the date the count starts from.

**R4. The renewed year.** When renewal dues are paid during grace, the renewed year still starts on the old renewal date. A membership not renewed by the end of the grace period lapses.

**R5. Auto-renew setting.** The member may switch auto-renew on or off at any time while the membership is active.

**R6. Benefit memberships.** A membership granted as a choice benefit renews at the member's expense only when the membership provides for a benefit membership to renew automatically.

**R7. Lifetime.** Summit Club Lifetime memberships never renew and never enter grace.

The grace period, the early-renewal period, the auto-renew default and the benefit-membership renewal setting are set per membership.

## Status over the renewal cycle

| Situation on the membership | Status | What the terms provide |
|---|---|---|
| Before the renewal date | Active | Dues fall due on the renewal date; they may be paid from the start of the early-renewal period |
| Renewal date passed with the renewal dues unpaid | Grace | Renewal dues may still be paid up to and including the last day of the grace period |
| Renewal dues paid during grace | Active again | The renewed year starts on the old renewal date |
| Grace period ended without renewal | Lapsed | — |

## Boundary days (hypothetical: renewal date 1 June; grace period taken as 30 calendar days)

| Day the renewal dues are paid | Within the grace period? | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 July — 30 calendar days after 1 June, the last day of the grace period | Yes; a payment on the last day is accepted | The membership is renewed, and the renewed year starts on 1 June |
| 2 July — the day after the last day | No | The renewal dues can no longer be paid; a membership not renewed by 1 July lapses |
| 20 June | Yes | Renewed; the renewed year still starts on 1 June, not on 20 June |

## Points of judgement

- **Where the clock starts.** The renewal date on the membership record, not the day the member calls or pays.
- **Calendar days.** Each calendar day counts, and equality with the last day satisfies the limit.
- **Lifetime.** A Summit Club Lifetime membership has no renewal and no grace status at any point.
